item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added a public preview for soft delete on logical servers. When a logical server is deleted, it enters a soft-deleted state and can be restored within the configured window.

  • Source: Azure Updates
